source_snapshot.procedure: Log in to the BMC Web UI and check GPU information fields Name, Version and Power.
source_snapshot.criteria: All information should display correct information.
source_snapshot.script: Two NVIDIA `nvidia-smi`/MIG-related internal script links are attached.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek substitutes generic `ipmitool sdr elist` and sensor output for TEMP_AMBIENT, which belongs to the other row sharing this code and cannot validate BMC WebUI GPU Name, Version or Power.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that the BMC WebUI GPU information page displays correct Name, Version and Power values for every GPU presented as in scope by the approved SUT recipe.
original_test_intent.target: The selected SUT's BMC WebUI GPU information view and the physical GPUs mapped to its displayed entries; this is not the same-code TEMP_AMBIENT sensor testcase on Functionality row 766.
original_test_intent.scope: Inspect the WebUI presentation of exactly Name, Version and Power for the recipe-defined GPU population, preserve the display evidence and compare those fields to owner-defined meanings and authoritative same-device references. UUID, BDF, driver, MIG or extra health fields are supporting identity only unless the recipe explicitly requires them.
original_test_intent.operation: Verify SUT/BMC/session identity, open the approved WebUI GPU page, capture all displayed GPU entries and the three source fields, map entries to the recipe, and compare values using the owner-defined Version/Power semantics. A documented read-only API or vendor host query may supply reference evidence but cannot replace proof of the WebUI display.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook estimates 5 attended and 5 machine minutes and describes one WebUI inspection.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every recipe-required GPU appears once in the BMC WebUI and its displayed Name, owner-defined Version and owner-defined Power value/unit match the approved reference and tolerance at a correlated timestamp. Unsupported/not-applicable fields are judged only if the platform specification permits them.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/BMC/GPU population and firmware identity; WebUI URL/page/version and timestamp; protected screenshots or UI export showing all entries and Name/Version/Power; field definitions, units and tolerance; recipe/reference values; minimal same-GPU identity correlation; per-entry comparison; no-mutation audit.
ambiguities: The source does not define whether Version means VBIOS, GPU firmware, GSP firmware, driver or another UI field.
The source does not define whether Power is instantaneous draw, average draw, limit/cap, rating or status, nor its unit/tolerance.
The required GPU count and mapping are delegated to an unspecified recipe.
Attached NVIDIA scripts suggest an NVIDIA environment but the Common branch and source text do not authorize applying NVIDIA semantics to an AMD GPU platform.
The same code appears on a different row for TEMP_AMBIENT, causing demonstrated cross-row contamination.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly rejects DeepSeek's ambient-sensor contamination, resolves field semantics before PASS and requires same-device recipe evidence. It makes the BMC WebUI and a supported management API appear interchangeable and expands OS GPU correlation beyond a supporting reference, which can let an agent pass the case without testing the source-required WebUI presentation.

applicable_history.decision: The code occurs at Functionality row 766 for TEMP_AMBIENT and row 1488 for GPU WebUI information. Identity is locked to row 1488; no sensor/SEL intent or evidence from row 766 may be reused.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Retain V2's classification and ambiguity controls, but make the BMC WebUI the mandatory tested interface. Host/API evidence is reference-only, and source-unrequested GPU fields must not replace Name, Version and Power.

available_now: The required UI location and three displayed field labels are explicit.
Read-only WebUI capture and reference queries are technically automatable when the authenticated browser/UI package is available.
The unrelated TEMP_AMBIENT overlay is definitively excluded by source row identity.
missing_inputs: Recipe-defined GPU population and mapping; exact BMC WebUI page/role for this firmware.
Owner definitions for Version and Power, including units, sampling meaning, reference source and tolerance.
A supported authenticated WebUI automation/capture package; vendor-specific read-only reference tool only when it matches the installed GPU vendor.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The platform/BMC owner supplies the GPU recipe, UI schema and field semantics; the lab package owner supplies secure browser automation and a matching NVIDIA/AMD reference method.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect SUT/BMC/GPU identities, discover the WebUI page, capture displayed labels/values and preserve raw read-only vendor inventory without making a PASS claim.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not substitute SDR/TEMP_AMBIENT, pass from host-only output, assume Version means VBIOS, assume Power means instantaneous draw, apply NVIDIA tools to AMD, clear logs, expose credentials, change MIG/power/clock/firmware/driver settings or invent UUID/BDF requirements.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Owner supplies the field dictionary and recipe; secure automation captures every required WebUI entry; each Name/Version/Power is mapped to the same GPU and compared with its correct reference/unit/tolerance; WebUI evidence remains primary.

revision_candidate.test_name: BMC WebUI GPU Name, Version and Power Display Check
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify the BMC WebUI's displayed Name, Version and Power for the recipe-defined GPU population against authoritative same-device references without changing GPU or BMC state.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact SUT, BMC firmware/WebUI release and installed NVIDIA or AMD GPU population covered by the approved recipe; vendor tools and field semantics must match that platform.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All GPU entries required by the recipe on the BMC WebUI GPU information page, limited to Name, Version and Power. Reference identifiers are used only to prevent cross-device comparison.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: SUT/BMC/GPU recipe and count; secure WebUI credential/session and page path; field definitions for Version and Power; units/reference/tolerance; supported browser capture; vendor-matched read-only reference command or API; protected evidence store.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Open the authenticated BMC WebUI GPU information page, capture all in-scope entries and exact Name/Version/Power labels and values with timestamps. Map entries to the approved recipe using the minimum available stable identity and compare each field to the owner-defined reference. Use `nvidia-smi`/NVML only for an NVIDIA target, or the approved AMD equivalent for AMD, as corroboration; never replace WebUI evidence or alter GPU state.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct SUT/BMC/firmware and GPU population verified; secure WebUI session available; field dictionary and recipe approved; vendor-specific reference tool qualified; logs preserved; no concurrent firmware/power/partitioning change.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: BMC/WebUI/recipe identity; complete protected WebUI screenshots/export for every required GPU; exact Name/Version/Power values, units and timestamps; field definitions and reference source; per-entry mapping/comparison and tolerance result; missing/N/A records; no-mutation audit.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The target BMC WebUI/schema and approved SUT GPU recipe define required fields and values. NVIDIA `nvidia-smi`/NVML documentation or the equivalent AMD documentation supports only vendor-matched reference interpretation and does not define the BMC UI contract.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Read only. Do not use the same-code TEMP_AMBIENT commands, change power caps/clocks/MIG/firmware/driver/BMC settings, clear logs, expose credentials, mix devices or vendors, or infer a field meaning from a similar label.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: No mutation approval is required. The platform owner must confirm the GPU scope and Version/Power semantics before final comparison; a human may perform the UI step if no approved browser automation package exists.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The agent can capture and compare once the UI and definitions exist. The owner judges ambiguous/N/A fields and product-specific tolerances; OS/API reference output cannot substitute for the requested WebUI observation.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No state recovery is expected. On UI, identity or field mismatch, preserve both UI and reference evidence, close sessions securely and resolve schema/recipe ambiguity before a bounded reread.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong SUT/BMC/GPU; stale/cross-host UI data; incomplete recipe; unresolved Version or Power meaning; missing unit/tolerance; vendor-tool mismatch; absent required UI field/entry; contradictory references; credential exposure; or any proposed state change.

identified_defects: DeepSeek evidence is copied from the same-code TEMP_AMBIENT row and is unrelated to GPU WebUI information.
Source field meanings and expected GPU population are unspecified.
V2 allows API/OS evidence to displace the mandatory WebUI observation.
Source log clearing is unrelated and destructive to diagnostic context.
reason_for_change: Preserve the WebUI-specific test instead of allowing technically valid host/API inventory to become a substitute, while keeping V2's correct requirement to resolve field semantics and remove cross-row ambient-sensor contamination.

new_technical_evidence.title: NVIDIA System Management Interface documentation
new_technical_evidence.applicability: NVIDIA GPUs with a compatible driver/NVML; not applicable to AMD GPUs or as a BMC WebUI specification
new_technical_evidence.supports: `nvidia-smi` can query all available GPUs, recommends UUID or PCI bus ID for stable device selection, reports VBIOS version, and distinguishes instantaneous/average power draw from multiple power-limit fields; unsupported values may be N/A.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The target GPU vendor, BMC field mapping, Version definition, Power definition and acceptable tolerance are not supplied.

removed_ambiguities: Locks the tested interface to BMC WebUI and makes host/API data reference-only.
Prevents automatic interpretation of Version and Power labels.
Excludes the other row's TEMP_AMBIENT evidence and vendor-inappropriate tools.
resolved_blockers: The incorrect SDR/TEMP_AMBIENT path is removed; a correct read-only UI/reference workflow is technically feasible.
remaining_blockers: GPU recipe/population, WebUI field semantics and acceptable Power comparison remain owner inputs.
Secure WebUI automation or an explicit human UI boundary must be supplied.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 preserves the source's actual WebUI subject, prevents a false pass from host-only inventory and confines extra identity fields to correlation while retaining V2's valid semantic and package prerequisites.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The contract is queued for the next isolated batch; no hardware or UI execution occurred.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 1488 is a BMC WebUI check of GPU Name, Version and Power and shares its code with an unrelated TEMP_AMBIENT row.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly rejects sensor evidence but permits API/OS results to blur the WebUI-specific subject.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow read-only UI and vendor-matched reference collection; prohibit settings changes, cross-row evidence and host-only completion.
